description: INSERT wired through the deferred-apply write set. An autocommit INSERT is applied at statement end; inside an explicit transaction the INSERT is visible to the transaction ITSELF through the read overlay (read-your-writes), a ROLLBACK discards it so it never reaches the base store, and a COMMIT applies every buffered insert at once. Converted 1:1 from transaction/InsertDeferredApplyTest (now retired); the Java built its own engine with transaction.deferredApply=true and toggled setAutoCommit, both of which the testkit backend supplies through the default engine plus an explicit BEGIN.
